messages:
Ravi Newhire: Hey folks, first-week newbie question: I can find the "Dev Templates" gallery but some templates are in English-only and our APAC team wants a localized copy. Is there an approved way to fork templates for translations without breaking the org gallery?
Harper DevEx: welcome Ravi! We generally recommend duplicating to your personal workspace, localizing there, then proposing the localized version as a separate org template (visibility: org, owner: <team>). Avoid moving the canonical template out of Eng space.
Ravi Newhire: ok. If I duplicate and translate, how do we keep sync metadata so the template CI doesn't fail (I saw "page-metadata-mismatch" on another PR)?
Lina Docs Maintainer: good question. Localized variants must include the same metadata table keys at the top: template: yes, owner: <team>, visibility: org, category: runbook|howto|onboarding, last-reviewed: YYYY-MM-DD. Put language as an additional tag like language: ja or language: en-US. The sync allows extra keys but requires the core keys to match exactly.
Ravi Newhire: nice. Also noticed that some duplicated templates lost linked relations to the centralized "Team runbooks" DB. Will that break the sync?
Lina Docs Maintainer: relations pointing to databases in another workspace won't automatically resolve after duplication. Best practice: add a note in the template "Add relation to Team runbooks db after publish" and include the canonical link. During PR review we can help wire relations if needed.
Ravi Newhire: who usually handles the pre-PR check? I don't want to iterate on CI errors.
Harper DevEx: drop the Notion link in #devex with "review-request" and tag @Lina Docs Maintainer or any Docs Maintainer. We'll do a quick pre-check for metadata and unresolved mentions before you open the PR.
Ravi Newhire: sweet. One more slightly awkward thing: when I duplicated I saw code blocks with sensitive example tokens. Should I scrub those before proposing?
Priya People Ops: absolutely scrub any secrets and replace with placeholders like <REDACTED_TOKEN>. For onboarding templates include a note on where to get the real creds (eg, request via SSM or Secrets Portal) rather than putting them inline.
Ravi Newhire: thanks. Last nit: is there an automation to tag templates by region? would save manual tagging.
Lina Docs Maintainer: we have a small script that reads the top property table and applies gallery tags if keys are exact. It's not region-aware yet. If you want it, file a docs-templates issue requesting region tagging (include sample metadata) and we'll prioritize. For now add language:<code> and owner:<team> tags.
notion-sync-bot: Tip: if PR CI returns "unresolved-mentions", replace org group mentions with plain text placeholders and add a review note. See "template-sync-checklist" in DevEx library.
Ravi Newhire: amazing, I'll duplicate, localize, add the required metadata (including language: ja), scrub secrets, and ask for a pre-review. Appreciate the help! :raised_hands:
